## What needs correcting?

Describe the claim, file, or section that appears wrong or out of date.

## Source

Link the current source, vendor documentation, regulator guidance, professional-body rule, or internal-reference repo.

## Suggested change

What should the playbook say instead?

## Sensitivity check

Do not include client, employer, employee, HR, legal, financial, health, confidential, regulated, proprietary, credential, or personal information.
